b2-concurrent-seat-lost-update.src/seat-inventory.mjs: const events=new Map();export function seedEvent(id,available){events.set(id,{id,available,bookedBy:[]});}export function getEvent(id){return events.get(id)??null;}export async function bookSeat(id,user,audit=async()=>{}){const event=events.get(id);if(event===undefined||event.available===0)return false;event.available--;event.bookedBy=event.bookedBy.concat(user);await audit({eventId:id,userId:user});return true;}
